candidate_text: Codex now preserves `enabled = false` for MCP servers after runtime and extension overlays. That matters for operators who disable `codex_apps` or same-name MCP servers and expect overlays not to re-enable them. PR: https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/27414
evidence_notes: MCP runtime config now records disabled server names before overlays.
Disabled state is restored after runtime fallback and extension overlay application.
Regression coverage exercises a disabled `codex_apps` server.
The PR body identifies same-name replacement overlays defaulting to enabled as the bug.

claims.text: Configured disabled MCP servers remain disabled after runtime overlays.
The regression-covered example is a disabled `codex_apps` server.

decision.reason: The PR fixes an operator-visible MCP safety boundary with clear source evidence.

caveats: Do not imply all MCP overlay precedence changed.
Keep `codex_apps` framed as the regression-covered example.
next_steps: Let Publisher automation decide whether to reserve or post this candidate.
Check Decodex MCP troubleshooting docs before making any Decodex support claim.
